figurative_meaning_en: observing a fruit-only diet, often for religious or ascetic reasons
example_sentences_in_bangla: উপবাসের দিনে সে ফলারে বামুনের মতো শুধু ফল খেল।
ধর্মীয় অনুষ্ঠানে ফলারে বামুন হয়ে থাকা তার রুটিন।
example_sentences_in_english: On fasting days, he eats only fruits like a fruit-eating Brahmin.
Observing a fruit-only diet like a Brahmin is his routine during religious ceremonies.
note: Refers to a Brahmin following a strict fruit-based diet, typically during Hindu fasts or vows of austerity.
